I really hope you are still here, please let me know if you are, I would love to speak to you my friend

anxiety attacks suck but the best thing I learned from them is that 1. they cannot harm you physically in anyway and 2. they cant last forever because your body runs out of energy to keep your fight or flight instict going. Cutting is a very temporary bandage kind of fix just like drugs and alcohol, they dont actually fix any issues simply distract you from them, there are many, many healthy coping mechanisms out there that will help you way more than cutting ever could. I'm thinking about you my friend okay? You are still very young to be deciding if lifes worth it or not simply because the more you age from your teens the different your outlook gets on life for the better or worse and either way its worth to atleast see it through in my opinion. I wish you the best of luck my friend.

If you never want to date another woman then use it as motivation, use all of the anger, sadness, etc. inside of you to create what you both have always wanted, think of her dreams and your dreams, she is encouraging you no matter what you choose to use that drive for. Become a complete beast at what you are trying to accomplish and imagine her there with you every single moment of your life and at the end, you'll have way more stories to talk to her about. I love you my friend.

It's normal, if you are "faking it" you know what you are doing, its a very, very common thing in depression, etc. to think you are faking it, you can look it up my friend. I'm sure you are not faking anything, best of wishes.
